anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex curve with a large radius of curvature along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak extension with high pixel thickness relative to visible length, projecting from the lower cranial margin.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point where the downward slope of the melon transitions into the rostrum at a shallow angle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular pale-colored spots or depigmented lesions are visible on the mid-lateral flank of the torso.
other_distinctive_markers: Total monochromatic cyan color cast across the subject; sharp pixel segmentation boundary against a black background.
